summary: Phase 149O.20L.7D.6 -- Action-9 Unexpected Residual Independent Diagnosis. Diagnosis-only (no repair, no Dell mutation, no source/contract change, no CHGR, no repair authorization, no DeploymentBinding, no certification, no activation). Independently reconfirmed live Dell state exactly matches 7D.5's post-execution baseline (no drift). Reconstructed the exact Action-9 invocation from the pinned proposition and reproduced the identical failing set {HBDC-REQ-022, -030, -035, -036, -042} read-only, once, for determinism. Read HBDC-001 v1.0 directly and traced each failing requirement to its exact verifier function and call path. HBDC-REQ-022/035: one shared root defect -- both call importlib.metadata.distribution("pcae") where the project's declared distribution name is pcae-harness; underlying properties independently confirmed already true on Dell -- PRODUCTION VERIFIER DEFECT, isolated to two exact literals. HBDC-REQ-036: a labeled diagnostic PATH counterfactual (not an authorized Action-9 rerun) proved widening Action-9's frozen PATH to include the venv bin/ resolves an already admin-controlled, agent-unwritable launcher with zero source change -- PROPOSITION / ACTION-9 INVOCATION DEFECT. HBDC-REQ-030 (mandatory trace): implicated path is the stock Ubuntu /usr/lib/python3.12/sitecustomize.py symlink; all three write channels (symlink, target, parent directory) independently confirmed closed to pcae -- FALSE DIAGNOSIS / REQUIREMENT ACTUALLY SATISFIED, caused by an overbroad unconditional symlink=writable heuristic; no repair required for compliance. HBDC-REQ-042 reconfirmed expected (no DeploymentBinding anywhere, no authority to create one). Causal graph: two independent root causes among the four unexpected failures (022+035 share one; 030 and 036 each independent), plus the separately-expected 042. Four blocking findings recorded (B-149O.20L.7D.6-1..-4). New, independently-authored companion test module, 21 tests, 3 consecutive clean runs, no flake. Recommends 149O.20L.7D.7 (narrow source repair for 022/035) -- not 7E.
